name: GimmeCalc Embed
author: asha2025

sections.description:
Add interactive calculators to your WordPress site in seconds. Search from 80+ ready-made calculators, pick one, and embed it — no coding, no signup, no API key.

Calculators cover health (BMI, body fat, calorie), finance (loan, mortgage, compound interest, salary), math (percentage, fraction, area), sports, and everyday conversions.

Available in three languages from three calculator portals:

  • GimmeCalc — English
  • Skaičiuoti — Lithuanian
  • Beregne — Norwegian

Features:

  • Searchable calculator picker in the block editor
  • Live preview in the editor
  • Customizable height and width
  • Lazy-loaded iframes for performance
  • No signup or API key required
  • Completely free — no premium tier

External services

This plugin connects to external calculator services to fetch calculator listings and display calculators on your site.

Services Used

  • GimmeCalc (gimmecalc.com) — English calculators
  • Skaiciuoti (skaiciuoti.lt) — Lithuanian calculators
  • Beregne (beregne.app) — Norwegian calculators

What data is sent and when

  • In the block editor: fetches the list of available calculators from the selected service. No user data is sent.
  • On the frontend: loads the selected calculator in an iframe. Your site URL is sent as a referrer query parameter.

Privacy Policies

  • GimmeCalc Privacy Policy
  • Skaiciuoti Privacy Policy
  • Beregne Privacy Policy

Terms of Service

  • GimmeCalc Terms of Service
  • Skaiciuoti Terms of Service
  • Beregne Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Search for “GimmeCalc” in the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the gimmecalc-embed folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Add the “GimmeCalc Embed” block in the block editor
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes, completely free. No signup, no API key, no premium tier.

Can I customize the size?

Yes. Use the sidebar controls to adjust height (200-800px) and width (full width or custom pixels).

Does it slow down my site?

No. The calculator loads in a lazy-loaded iframe that only renders when visible on screen.

What calculators are available?

Over 80 calculators including BMI, loan, mortgage, compound interest, unit converters, and many more. Browse the full list at gimmecalc.com.

Does it work with the classic editor?

No. GimmeCalc Embed is a Gutenberg block and requires the block editor.
